page_title: MAR 5-2 PAR | Marseille v Paris FC 23/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' 5 - 2 It’s a GOAL! It looked impossible to score from that angle, but Robinio Vaz (Marseille) somehow finds the net with a cheeky shot past the keeper from close in.

90+4' The most active player in today's match is definitely Mason Greenwood (Marseille). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
90+1' The game has come to an end for Amine Gouiri. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Darryl Bakola (Marseille).
90+1' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Derek Cornelius (Marseille) replacing Ulisses Garcia.
90+1' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90+1' One of the Paris FC players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
89' Paris FC will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
89' We are about to witness a very dangerous free kick from the edge of the box! Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) will be the one to show us his shooting technique.
88' Robinio Vaz (Marseille) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
87' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) takes a short corner kick.
85' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) can't convert the spot kick. It goes narrowly wide of the left post.
85' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
85' Mamadou Mbow (Paris FC) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. The referee points to the penalty spot. PENALTY to Marseille!
84' Paris FC are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
83' Stephane Gilli prepares a substitution. Nhoa Sangui is replaced by Julien Lopez (Paris FC).
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vincent Marchetti trots off the pitch and is replaced by Pierre-Yves Hamel (Paris FC).
81' 4 - 2 What an absolute cracking goal! Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) hits a perfect volley from long range and the ball flies into the bottom left corner. Take a bow son.
81' Bilal Nadir (Marseille) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
78' Alimani Gory (Paris FC) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
74' The referee allows time for a substitution. Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang will be replaced by Robinio Vaz (Marseille).

73' 3 - 2 Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 3:2.
73' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
72' Michael Murillo (Marseille) trips an opposition player and Marc Bollengier signals a foul.
71' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
70' Bilal Nadir (Marseille) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. Now Marseille have a corner.
70' Angel Gomes (Marseille) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
69' A substitution has been made. Adama Camara is replaced by Lohann Doucet (Paris FC).
68' Angel Gomes (Marseille) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.

65' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) picks up a rebound, makes a bit of ground then unleashes a shot from distance that dips at the last second and flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
64' Substitution. Alimani Gory (Paris FC) replaces Willem Geubbels.
64' Stephane Gilli has decided to make a change. Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) replaces Moses Simon.
63' Substitution. Bilal Nadir (Marseille) has come on for Timothy Weah.
62' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

61' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper. Marseille have been awarded a corner kick.
61' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) takes the corner.
60' Michael Murillo (Marseille) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

58' 2 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Ilan Kebbal slips the ball through to Moses Simon (Paris FC), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent low shot into the back of the net. He makes it 2:2.

55' What a chance that is! Maxime Lopez swings the ball into the box, and Moses Simon (Paris FC) gets in front of his man and powers his header just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.

54' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Mason Greenwood (Marseille) is going to have a crack himself.
53' Marc Bollengier couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Mamadou Mbow (Paris FC) and blew his whistle. Marseille have a free kick from a promising distance.
52' Otavio (Paris FC) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.

51' Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Marc Bollengier blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Paris FC, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
49' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Paris FC.
48' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
46' Samir Chergui (Paris FC) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is behind the touchline and Marseille will take a throw-in.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.

45+3' Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the right post. The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one. The ball goes out of play and Paris FC will have a goal kick.
45+2' A pass by Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
45+1' Half-chance! Michael Murillo (Marseille) plays a pass into the box, but Obed Nkambadio reacts well to snuff out the attack.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) sends a chip pass into the box, but Geronimo Rulli is quickest to intercept the ball.
44' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
42' A player from Paris FC commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
42' The referee awards a corner and Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) goes over to take it.
42' Nhoa Sangui (Paris FC) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Paris FC.

41' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity.
39' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
39' The Paris FC players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

37' Great solo effort by Moses Simon (Paris FC) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the roof of the net. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save.
36' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle and it's Michael Murillo (Marseille) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
35' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) latches on to a brilliant through ball in a promising position, but one of the defenders is alert to the danger and dispossess him.
33' Some patient build-up play from Marseille as they look to unlock the defence.
32' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul after Adama Camara (Paris FC) hacks down one of his opponents. Marseille earn a free kick.
31' Timothy Weah (Marseille) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Paris FC will have a goal kick.
30' The total number of attempts is 3:3. Shots on target – 2:1.

28' 2 - 1 Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Geronimo Rulli is just a bystander as the ball flies into the top left corner. The score is 2:1.
27' Moses Simon (Paris FC) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

24' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Mason Greenwood delivers a teasing cross from the resulting corner and the ball falls into the space where Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) is lurking. His precise shot from close range goes straight into the bottom left corner and it's 2:0.
24' The linesman points to the corner flag, Marseille are going to take it.
22' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) makes a slide tackle, but referee Marc Bollengier blows for a foul. Marseille have been awarded a free kick.
21' Geronimo Rulli displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Moses Simon (Paris FC) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

20' Good chance! Vincent Marchetti (Paris FC) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
18' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Mason Greenwood (Marseille) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Obed Nkambadio no chance!
18' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) is going to take the penalty!
16' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Marseille!
15' There's a break in play and referee Marc Bollengier must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Marseille using VAR. This could be interesting!
14' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
13' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and fires at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort only hits the left-hand post!
12' Timothy Weah (Marseille) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
11' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) sends a long ball forward to Amine Gouiri, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
10' The ball possession at the moment is 78:22.
9' The ball is cleared after Mason Greenwood (Marseille) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball has crossed the sideline. Marseille are taking a throw-in.

7' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.

6' Post! Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the centre of the box wasn't accurate enough and the ball crashed against the right post! The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
5' The referee blows his whistle after Angel Gomes (Marseille) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
4' Moses Simon (Paris FC) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Paris FC.
3' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) plays a one-two with Michael Murillo, but the move breaks down.
2' Marseille seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Marseille will take the kick-off.
Marc Bollengier got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
